verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so an official MCP server that exposes its mailbox to outside agents is a fair question. The evidence only shows the opposite direction: Shortwave's own AI Assistant connects to third-party MCP servers via "Add custom integration". Nothing documents a first-party MCP server or endpoint that external agents can connect to, and that client-side integration does not count toward this server-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
